newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israel allies, Hizbollah swap dead fighters.
newsitem.headline: Israel allies, Hizbollah swap dead fighters.

text.p: The pro-Iranian Hizbollah and Israel's client South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia swapped on Friday the remains of two militiamen for two dead guerrillas.

A spokesman for Hizbollah (Party of God) said group officials handed over the remains of two SLA fighters it holds to officials of the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) in Beirut's southern suburbs in the morning.

In exchange, the militant group received from ICRC delegates the remains of two Hizbollah guerrillas held by the SLA, at a checkpoint linking Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone to the rest of the region, the spokesman added.
The pro-Iranian Hizbollah leads a guerrilla war on Israeli and SLA forces in a bid to drive them from the south Lebanon border zone set up to protect north Israel from guerrilla raids.

In July, Hizbollah and Israel exchanged the remains of two Israeli soldiers held by the fundamentalists for a decade for the bodies of 123 guerrillas. The German-brokered deal also secured the release of 45 captives by the SLA and the return of 17 SLA militiamen held captive by Hizbollah.
